icons.name: bell
icons.prompt: Create ONE production icon asset on a truly transparent RGBA background. Reference role: supplied image is the approved Storybook miniatures style and exact source for this subject. It has a warm softly shaded gold-brass body, dark warm brown contours, a tiny top handle and rounded dark clapper. This must be that exact design, not a modern outline notification bell.
